strategy_source_invariant: company-wiki is the sole ownership and strategy source for the seven data-lake contracts. filing-fetch and revenue-forecast consume these contracts; they must never re-declare ownership, define a second root policy / allowlist source, or re-implement identity, latest, artifact, or admission logic. A second owner_repo entry for any contract is a forbidden second strategy source.

RootPolicySnapshot.compat_window: N (2.x RootPolicy) and N-1 (1.x kind-based) coexist from FC-301; scanner uses 2.x via adapter registry while 1.x remains read-only fallback.
RootPolicySnapshot.deletion_deadline: 1.x kind-based policy and its loader/doctor are deleted only after FC-305 cutover and Phase 14 R9, contingent on two consecutive >=24h zero-hit observation windows.
RootPolicySnapshot.field_owner_note: Fields defined in architecture_target.md section 3 (root_id, path_ref, adapter_id, admission_profile_id, read_only, reusable_for_filing, allowed_document_kinds, canonical_write_target, priority, cohort). Consumers verify the policy snapshot hash only.

NormalizedFilingMetadata.compat_window: Normalized metadata is produced by adapters (FC-302) and bound via no-guess backfill (FC-402); legacy containers remain read-only until the normalized-only resolver (FC-701) removes their production callers.
NormalizedFilingMetadata.deletion_deadline: Legacy acquisition/dayu_meta containers are deleted after FC-705 proves two consecutive >=24h windows with zero legacy-bridge hits.
NormalizedFilingMetadata.field_owner_note: Fields defined in architecture_target.md section 4. Filename is evidence hint only; unprovable fields enter remediation, never capture-ready.

ResolutionEnvelope.n_minus_1_supported: not-applicable (new contract; pre-cutover consumers see explicit bundle_status=unavailable per FC-903)
ResolutionEnvelope.compat_window: First codified in FC-704. Older company-wiki returns without bundle; filing-fetch must surface bundle_status=unavailable rather than synthesize a green response (FC-903).
ResolutionEnvelope.deletion_deadline: No deletion; successor versions carry a new minor version and an N-1 window declared in a future FC before any breaking change.
ResolutionEnvelope.deletion_deadline_fc_gate: no-break contract; any breaking change requires a new FC
ResolutionEnvelope.field_owner_note: Returns handle + bundle + policy/epoch + true outcome + exclusion/debug trace (FC-704).

AcquisitionTrace.n_minus_1_supported: not-applicable (new contract; replaces inferred download_calls pseudo-evidence)
AcquisitionTrace.compat_window: Codified in FC-704; distinguishes reused_existing, reused_after_discovery, downloaded_new, gap, ambiguous, rejected from the journal.
AcquisitionTrace.deletion_deadline: No deletion; breaking change requires a new FC and N-1 window.
AcquisitionTrace.deletion_deadline_fc_gate: no-break contract; any breaking change requires a new FC
AcquisitionTrace.field_owner_note: Outcome is reconstructed from the journal/event log, never inferred from handle presence (FC-704, FC-905).

SourceBundle.compat_window: Production-produced from FC-902; must be snapshot-consistent (same policy/epoch/document hash as the handle). Unknown artifact role fails closed.
SourceBundle.deletion_deadline: No deletion; breaking change requires a new FC and N-1 window.
SourceBundle.deletion_deadline_fc_gate: no-break contract; any breaking change requires a new FC
SourceBundle.field_owner_note: filing-fetch forwards the bundle; revenue must invoke the selector against it (FC-904). Never test/CLI-only.

ArtifactHandle.compat_window: Bound artifacts (2.0) coexist with legacy_unbound (1.0) from FC-901; only source/document/content/generator/schema-proven artifacts bind, the rest stay legacy_unbound and are preserved but not reused.
ArtifactHandle.deletion_deadline: legacy_unbound artifacts are never deleted; they are excluded from reuse. Their store rows remain until a separate, explicitly authorized cleanup FC.
ArtifactHandle.deletion_deadline_fc_gate: FC-901 dry-run ledger + future authorized cleanup FC
ArtifactHandle.field_owner_note: Reuse requires all of source/content/bytes/schema/generator/upstream-bundle hash equality (architecture_target.md section 6).

ActivationSnapshot.n_minus_1_supported: not-applicable (replaces hardcoded runtime flags / WU-script dicts)
ActivationSnapshot.compat_window: The persistent, versioned runtime policy snapshot from FC-201; request start pins policy_hash + activation_epoch + cohort for the whole request.
ActivationSnapshot.deletion_deadline: No deletion; the snapshot is the single activation authority. Hardcoded flags/dicts it replaces are deleted in FC-201.
ActivationSnapshot.field_owner_note: flag=false hides active rows even if present; shadow rows never affect active response (architecture_target.md section 5).
